explication: This repository is a curated prompt-and-image showcase for GPT‑4o and gpt-image-1, rather than an image-generation service. Readers browse the bilingual README and case collection for prompts, images, and attribution; the separate gpt-image-1 collection highlights official-model examples. The generator loads case YAML and attribution, localizes and renders content from templates, then writes the README files. Source excerpts establish the generator’s file reads and localization import; links from the catalog to the collections are documented in the README.
